content.title: Open the in-page security modal from the preview
content.intent: Prove OPEN SECURITY in the preview opens the in-page modal and the modal shows the required security detail sections.
content.technique_notes: Techniques: state_flow for the preview-to-modal transition; equivalence partitioning for the OPEN SECURITY action as the modal-entry class. strength=2 by risk judgement because no money, auth, or data-loss factors apply; no covering-array sweep was needed because this path varies by a single entry action.
